rationale: F45 Provider Resilience is a low-risk backend hardening feature with 4 tasks across 2 waves. T01 creates a custom exception hierarchy, T02 refactors provider _fetch to use typed exceptions, T03-T04 add re-queue logic to scan and sync orchestrators. No frontend changes, no DB schema changes. Files are well-scoped and the plan has clear sequential dependencies (T01->T02->T03/T04). Strong test coverage (1625 backend tests, 91.08%) provides safety net. No blockers.
